authority_notes: CONTRACT STATUS: discovery projection, NOT authority. The scripts under pig-fb/ and tandem/ are the sole authority for what these capabilities do; this file is a human/machine-readable index for discovery. If it drifts from the implementation, the implementation wins.
Meta AI receives only the research prompt text; it never sees this descriptor, SSH, or JSON.
research.ask output is typed unverified-external-research: the Muse verification gate (outreach engine step 4e) runs before anything enters the pipeline or PING.
Meta never emits to PING; emission is Muse-only via tandem/emit-observation.py post-verification.

artifact.read.description: Byte-exact file transfer from Pig to cloud. No re-encoding, no PowerShell text pipeline.
artifact.read.timeout: PIG_TIMEOUT sets SSH ConnectTimeout (default 25s); it is NOT a total-operation bound, slow transfers may exceed it

artifact.write.description: Byte-exact file transfer from cloud to Pig (transfer buffers, drivers, prompts).
artifact.write.timeout: PIG_TIMEOUT sets SSH ConnectTimeout (default 25s); it is NOT a total-operation bound

browser.status.description: Preflight for the headed Chrome/CDP substrate. Recovers via the existing PigiFBLogin watchdog task if CDP is down; never touches Nolan's personal Chrome profile.

outputs.status: exit 0 CDP up (login checked separately by check_cdp.js); exit 1 CDP down after recovery attempt

job.record.description: Append exactly one terminal JSONL run record per invocation. Outcomes: ok, capture_failed, infra; signals record outcome unknown with classification terminated_by_signal_TERM/INT.
job.record.idempotency_note: append-only: each invocation appends exactly one record; reruns append, never rewrite
job.record.note: Append-only. A ledger-write failure can never conceal the primary run outcome.

outputs.ledger_line: run_id, job_ref, mission_id, initiated_by, auth_ref, brief_id, research_agent, locator, pack_version, started_at/completed_at, exit_code, outcome, classification, artifact_refs, validation, ping_refs, ping_outcome, last_verified_state, resumable, resume_note

research.ask.description: Send a research brief plus context pack to Meta AI through the Pig's logged-in headed Chrome (CDP :9223) and return the raw captured answer. Prompt is assembled as a deterministic three-section contract: OBJECTIVE (brief verbatim, first), CONTEXT (pack verbatim, second), OUTPUT CONTRACT (validator constants, third, authoritative over any pack directives).

inputs.brief_ref: slug of a brief under tandem/prompts/

research.ask.note: Output is UNVERIFIED external research until the Muse verification gate. Never promoted into canonical PING claims directly. Capture is DOM innerText (rendered text, lossy); byte-exactness holds only for the later scp pull-back.

outputs.locator: winning fallback-ladder locator id, logged to runs.jsonl for drift telemetry
outputs.raw_capture: rendered answer text on success; prompt echo or partial text on failure (never discarded)

research.ask.timeout: ~15 minutes (Meta AI researches at its own pace)

research.context.description: Build a versioned context pack from authoritative source artifacts (never from memory). Content-addressed and cached.

retention.sweep.description: Delete Pig-side transfer buffers older than 7 days. Dry-run by default; --apply to delete. Never touches the Chrome profile, runtime, or scripts. Pig-side originals referenced in runs.jsonl pig_answer ARE deleted after 7 days; local timestamped copies remain and provenance is preserved via the ledger.

validation.run.description: Answer presence validation: strict UTF-8 decode (BOM only, fails loudly), requires >=3 numbered items and >1200 chars. Shape check only, never a truth check. Fails closed.

inputs.out_path: where to write the .md on pass
inputs.ts: run timestamp for the file header

contract_status_note: This file is a discovery projection for Muse, not an authority. Capability behavior is defined solely by the implementations named in implemented_by. A contract test (pig-fb/test-capabilities.py) checks this file against the implementations; fix the file when the test fails, never the reverse.
description: Machine-readable capability index for the Pig execution substrate. Its consumer is Muse (the orchestrator), not Meta AI: Meta AI only ever sees a research prompt and returns text. The underlying transport (SSH via pig-ssh.sh, CDP loopback) is intentionally not named here. Bump version when a capability is added, removed, or its contract changes.
